dogecoin.text: Us workers probably work more than most millionaires and billionaires. If we continually buy doge and hodl with our own *labored* money, the wealth transfers from rich companies/businesses to a meme currency that we all own #dogecoin
The professionals say dogecoin (or any crypto currency) has no intrinsic value. Wouldn’t transactions like funding a rocket to space put the intrinsic in the value it already has?
